inlines.v: TRIP'ARTITE, adjective [Latin tripartitus; tres, three, and partitus, divided; partior.] 1. Divided into three parts. In botany, a tripartite leaf is one which is divided into three parts down to the base, but not wholly separate. 2. Having three corresponding parts or copies; as indentures tripartite
